assets.prompt: Create one ultra-wide clean illustrated production contact sheet 3 columns × 2 rows of SIX evenly sized 16:9 classroom background images, edge-to-edge, all separated by thin flat bright hot pink #ff00ff two gutters vertically and one horizontally, no outer margin. Layout total ratio 8:3 ideally and aim high pixel resolution. These will be cropped to six separate scenes for a first-grade Chinese elementary math animated lesson at a tiny modern neighbourhood post room. Bright clear sky, natural honey wood, pine-teal green, clean ivory, some coral red and little golden accents. Use a cohesive elegant tactile 3-D stop-motion book illustration look, colorful but soft, use friendly warm skin and natural anatomy. Top left: exterior of a tiny teal-orange community post room with neutral envelope emblem only and two Chinese elementary school children from afar in a quiet residential courtyard, on right half, plain sunny light area on left for teacher overlay. Top middle: inside its wood post counter, clean large open empty countertop, empty center, friendly mint shelving in far background, no objects in front. Top right: overhead garden and teal mint floor with grass and pale apricot surrounding border, EMPTY in center as a low-contrast smooth stage for a drawn maze grid, no built-in maze, no characters. Bottom left: side-on low perspective exterior sidewalk, a wide flat empty path across center, only soft out of focus mint and amber houses in distance; no traffic, no people, no bins. Bottom middle: close-up of Chinese child and parent doing a paper and cards activity together, they occupy right half, a quiet empty beige desk on left; no numbers or lettering. Bottom right: blank distinct simplified post counter with cream cork backdrop and wide quiet empty light center for diagrams, unobtrusive teal wall edge. No words, no digits, no letters, no text or readable markings anywhere. Do not draw arrays of objects, beads or piles of quantities. No borders except solid hot pink internal gutters.
